objective: At n = 2^m, h = n/2, for a in GF(2n)* with b = sqrt(a): prove (1) Z(w) = S + w^(1-n) M_(eps(w^-2 k)) on F[k]_(<h) satisfies det Z(w) = w^(h(1-n)) det(I + C_s(w)), Z(a) = X_b, and its Taylor coefficients at a beyond the first are multiplications; (2) the partial multiplicities of Z at a are those of the J x J moment form on ker X_b = G_b F[Y]_(<J) given by the Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction (Z is self-adjoint for every w); and, as the target, (3) the chain lemma: G_b Y^j heads a Jordan chain of length exactly 2k - 1 - 4j, k = h - deg G_b, for j < ceil(k/2), and these are the partial multiplicities, so the algebraic multiplicity of 1/a is k(k + 1)/2 with k = h - deg G_b; or the point where the chains fall short. Found by exact computation before registration: (3) at every a for sides 8 to 32.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand, with finite checks; pre-registered in 25ab6ffa4): at sides 2^m the family Z(w) carrying the cone's spectrum (det Z = w^(h(1-n)) det(I + C_s)) is S + (a + delta) M_(Phi(a^2 + delta^2)) near each eigenvalue parameter a and self-adjoint at every w; its first-order term on the eigenvectors G Y^j is a^-1 times the Hankel matrix of the top coefficients of the norm N(G) = G(k) G(k + 1), of degree h - k in Y, so each eigenvalue has exactly k mod 2 Jordan blocks of size 1; a^-1 k G Y^i is the second vector of the chain G Y^i heads when 2i < k - 1. Computed exactly: G Y^j heads a Jordan chain of exactly 2k - 1 - 4j, these being the blocks, at every a for sides 8 to 64 (64 registered before it was run) and nine values of a at side 128 (stress test pending at closure), so the multiplicity k(k + 1)/2 is read off deg G alone. The chain lemma beyond first order is not proved.
title: The chains that one polynomial heads
